textIndex.pooling: Attention-mask mean pooling over 254-token content chunks plus CLS/SEP, then token-count-weighted pooling of normalized chunk vectors and final L2 normalization.
textIndex.ranking: Reading/document anchors use only MiniLM cosine among reading/document candidates. Visual/media anchors retain CLIP cosine across all materials. Scores from different spaces are never mixed.
